# Altitude.com

> Altitude.com is an elite-level .com domain that is for sale. It is being brokered by ATM Holdings. It was previously owned by a large company.

## Key facts

- Domain: Altitude.com (one dictionary word, eight letters, .com)
- Status: for sale / available to acquire
- Broker: ATM Holdings — https://atmholdings.com/
- Previous owner: a large company
- Enquiries: AMiller@atmholdings.com (subject: "Domain inquiry: Altitude.com")
- Price: not published; handled directly by the broker

## Suitable industries

"Altitude" means height or elevation — how far above the ground something has climbed — so the name is not tied to one category. It suits aviation and aerospace, drones and air mobility, outdoor and mountaineering, travel and hospitality, sport and performance, health and wellbeing, finance and wealth, software and AI, weather and climate, space and satellites, real estate and high-rise, and leadership and consulting.
